title.native: 七つの魔剣が支配する

synonyms: ซ่อนคมเวทเจ็ดดาบมาร
description:
It’s springtime at Kimberly Magic Academy, and new students are beginning their first year. Among them are a skilled and studious boy, Oliver, and a headstrong samurai girl, Nanao. They soon form a unique bond in the halls of Kimberly, but this picturesque school isn’t what it seems. Dark secrets and endless danger lurk behind every corner. Can these wizards make it to graduation alive?!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

node.description: Hailing from Tourikueisen in the distant country of Yamatsukuni, Nanao is a samurai girl who was offered a second chance at life by Theodore McFarlane. She attends Kimberly at his behest and finds a new purpose in life in crossing blades with [Oliver Horn](https://anilist.co/character/258618/Oliver-Horn). She is a noble and cheerful person who holds honor in high regards, and a good fight even moreso.

Oliver attends Kimberly Magic Academy to better refine his vast skills. Upon arriving, he meets the likes of [Nanao](https://anilist.co/character/258620/Nanao-Hibiya), [Chela](https://anilist.co/character/258624/Michela-McFarlane), [Katie](https://anilist.co/character/258626/Katie-Aalto), [Guy](https://anilist.co/character/258621/Guy-Greenwood), and [Pete](https://anilist.co/character/258623/Pete-Reston), their tight-knit bond eventually leading to the formation of the Sword Roses alliance.

Oliver is a gentle, rational, thoughtful and caring boy. Although less outwardly emotional than others, he’s intelligent, brave and cares for his friends. Oliver generally takes every situation calmly but can quickly lose his temper when someone he's close to is harmed.

~!In reality, his goal in attending Kimberly is to systematically eliminate every Kimberly instructor involved in the torture and murder of his mother, [Chloe Halford](https://anilist.co/character/341944/Chloe-Halford). To achieve this, he uses the powerful Fourth Spellblade Chloe originally possessed.!~

name.native: ミシェーラ＝マクファーレン

node.description: A friend of [Oliver](https://anilist.co/character/258618/Oliver-Horn)'s and a member of the Sword Roses. Chela is a proud young lady and the eldest daughter of the noble house of McFarlane, one of the five oldest families in Yelgland, and among the elite in the Magical World. She is an incredibly skilled mage, and often serves as the Sword Roses' voice of reason alongside Oliver as the two most mature members of the group.

A friend of [Oliver](https://anilist.co/character/258618/Oliver-Horn)'s and a member of the Sword Roses. Katie has very strong ideals compared to the typical mage, desiring to reform magical society's treatment of demi-humans. She appears to have a crush on Oliver and in contrast often finds herself at odds with [Guy](https://anilist.co/character/258621/Guy-Greenwood), although they remain close friends and seem to have a slight cooking rivalry amongst themselves.

A friend of [Oliver](https://anilist.co/character/258618/Oliver-Horn)'s and a member of the Sword Roses. Pete is a mage born into a nonmagical family that enters Kimberly after scoring well on their difficult entrance exam. he forms a strong bond with the Sword Roses, who support him in his learning about the magical world and becoming stronger in it.

~!It is later revealed that Pete is reversi. This means that his body can change sex.!~

name.native: オフィーリア＝サルヴァドーリ

node.description:
An upperclassman at Kimberly Magic Academy. Ophelia is a mysterious witch from a family of succubi who lives in the depths of the academy's labyrinth. She was once a normal student who, after enduring distressing events, left the academy to perfect her magical arts in the labyrinth. She is on the verge of being consumed by the spell and creates chimeras to kidnap new students.

~!As a child, Ophelia suffered from unwanted advances as a result of her succubus trait of "Perfume". She grew up distrusting of people before meeting [Carlos](https://anilist.co/character/304175/Carlos-Whitrow), who was unaffected by her Perfume due to their nature as a Castrato. Later she meets [Godfrey](https://anilist.co/character/267388/Alvin-Godfrey), who was affected by her Perfume but constantly cast spells to hurt himself when this happened, eventually training his body to overcome the effect. This effort caused Ophelia to open up and fall in love for the first time, though she never told Godfrey about her feelings.!~

A strange fourth-year student fascinated by demi-humans. Miligan is an excellent witch with great abilities and a few secrets. Despite her almost fanatical pursuit of her goals, she loves the younger students and enjoys teaching them. She takes an interest in [Katie](https://anilist.co/character/258626/Katie-Aalto), taking her on as a research partner and apprentice.

~!Her covered left eye is that of a basilisk. This cursed eye was transplanted into her by her parents despite the great risk to her survival in doing so.!~

A friend of [Oliver](https://anilist.co/character/258618/Oliver-Horn)'s and a member of the Sword Roses. Guy is cheerful and friendly, with a frank and pleasant personality and great thoughtfulness and concern towards his friends. He's unusually talented with the use of magical flora.

~!Guy later awakens as a curse user and has to temporarily leave the Sword Roses until he is able to control his powers, which upsets his friends, particularly [Katie](https://anilist.co/character/258626/Katie-Aalto).!~

A student at Kimberly Magic Academy. She is in the year below the Sword Roses.

~!Teresa is a follower of [Oliver Horn](https://anilist.co/character/258618/Oliver-Horn) in his revenge plot against Kimberly's instructors. Born and raised in the labyrinth, she is a master of survival and espionage, with unparalleled stealth skills.!~

name.native: カルロス＝ウィットロウ

node.description:
An upperclassman at Kimberly Magic Academy. Carlos is an androgynous youth with a beautiful voice. They were assigned male at birth but was rendered Castrato—magically neutered—in order to be rendered immune to [Ophelia Salvadori](https://anilist.co/character/258625/Ophelia-Salvadori)'s Perfume.

Alongside Ophelia they befriended [Alvin Godfrey](https://anilist.co/character/267388/Alvin-Godfrey) and co-founded the Kimberly Campus Watch with him, [Tim Linton](https://anilist.co/character/341942/Tim-Linton) and [Lesedi Ingwe](https://anilist.co/character/341949/Lesedi-Ingwe). A falling-out with Ophelia later inspired Carlos to form a club to support students with gender and sex-linked magics like hers.

Esmeralda is the headmistress of Kimberly Magic Academy. Her fame—and infamy—extends far beyond the Union’s borders. Due to mysterious circumstances, she is afflicted with strange, untreatable headaches.

~!Esmeralda is able to devour the souls of mages she has defeated. She inherited this ability through her clan's vampiric ancestry, and has used it to consume the souls of over one hundred mages, starting with her former comrade and [Oliver](https://anilist.co/character/258618/Oliver-Horn)'s mother, [Chloe Halford](https://anilist.co/character/341944/Chloe-Halford). Her repeated usage of this ability is the cause of her incurable headaches.!~

A student at Kimberly Magic Academy and a classmate of the Sword Roses. Ytallian by birth, Rossi taught himself the sword by ignoring the fundamentals out of dislike for the three standard Sword Arts styles. He has sharp instincts and his combat style is based around dirty play.

His lack of fundamentals caused him to lose to [Oliver](https://anilist.co/character/258618/Oliver-Horn), who had practiced the fundamentals to the point of pain, in a duel. He has since pursued the study of both the Koutz Style and magicombat to improve his skills.

name.native: アルヴィン＝ゴットフレイ

node.description:
An upperclassman at Kimberly Magic Academy and the current Student Council President. Godfrey is kind and compassionate towards the younger students, protecting them from the more twisted attendants of the school.

Godfrey was born with abnormally high mana reserves for a non-noble mage and he has a strong affinity for fire magic, giving him his nickname "Purgatory". He boasts incredible firepower, strong enough even to injure the powerful instructors of the academy.

~!Godfrey graduates from Kimberly at the end of the 1534 school year and resolves to join the Gnostic Hunters, an organization of battlemages that fight against the encroachment of the world by creatures and beings from other realities.!~

name.native: リチャード＝アンドリューズ

node.description: A student at Kimberly Magic Academy and a classmate of the Sword Roses. He is the heir to the Andrews noble family. Initially seeing [Oliver](https://anilist.co/character/258618/Oliver-Horn) as a rival after misunderstandings that antagonized the two, he later duels him in a proper rematch and begins to see him as a friend.

name.native: サイラス＝リヴァーモア

node.description: An upperclassman at Kimberly Magic Academy. Rivermoore is a necromancer who controls the bones of the dead, and is considered equally dangerous as [Ophelia](https://anilist.co/character/258625/Ophelia-Salvadori).

name.native: ダリウス＝グレンヴィル

node.description: Darius Grenville is the Alchemy Instructor of Kimberly Magic Academy. He is famous for stealing research results from the brighter students and presenting them as his own theories. Darius thinks very highly of himself. He looks down on his students and doesn't hesitate to let them know that, often speaking very ill of those he dislikes.

name.native: エンリコ フェルギェーリ

node.description: The magical engineering instructor at Kimberly Magic Academy. Enrico is prone to designing outrageous lessons designed to maim students. His forte is making golems, and he believes the pursuit of sorcery and technology lies outside the bounds of morality. He was the teacher of [Chloe Halford](https://anilist.co/character/341944/Chloe-Halford), and later, a Gnostic Hunter working alongside her.
